initialExam.title: Sikkim PSC 2026
initialExam.description: Sikkim PSC conducts the Sikkim State Civil Service examination for recruitment to Group A and Group B administrative posts in Sikkim state government.
initialExam.syllabus: General Studies, English, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, Sikkim GK & Culture.
initialExam.jobRole: SCS Officer, Administrative posts in Sikkim
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit spsc.sikkim.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, Pension, Hill area allowance

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: SC/ST: 5 years, as per state rules
